BidExtraction.description: Everything extracted from one tenderer's offer.

fx_to_hkd.description: Conversion rate to HKD if quoted in a foreign currency
fx_to_hkd.title: Fx To Hkd

optimal_dosage.description: Optimal dosage, only for cost-effectiveness schemes
optimal_dosage.title: Optimal Dosage

quoted_total.description: Estimated goods price as quoted by the tenderer, if stated
quoted_total.title: Quoted Total

tenderers.description: default: every tenderer with an uploaded offer
tenderers.title: Tenderers

CheckType.description:
The only menu of checks a rule may use. Twelve kinds; a short fixed menu is what
makes an LLM-drafted rule checkable by code.
CheckType.title: CheckType

ChecklistItem.description: One Stage I completeness item (a form/schedule/certificate that must be present).

item.description: What must be submitted, e.g. 'Signed Tender Form (G.F.230)'
item.title: Item

source_file.description: Tender file (### FILE header) stating it
source_file.title: Source File

ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem

Citation.description:
Where a value or a rule comes from. `quote` is verbatim; `node_id` is the clause
node from the parser (e.g. "Supp:13:(a)") or None for a page-level citation when the
document's structure was too messy to trust.

candidates.description: when the resolver matched several nodes: every node id it found; node_id is the one chosen, a person may pick another
candidates.title: Candidates

file.description: path relative to the project, e.g. 'tender/09 Schedules.pdf'
file.title: File

Citation.title: Citation

evidence.description: Short quote or observation supporting the finding
evidence.title: Evidence

Consequence.description:
What a blank or failing field means for one rule, before any rule-level override.
The seven tiers the rule files use. The default outcomes for a tier are defined per
template (`Template.consequences`), because they differ from form to form.
Consequence.title: Consequence

CorrectionRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /bids/{t}/fields/{letter}/{field}` (S4): correct a value, mark a
document present or absent, or point at another page. `Correction` is the stored record.
CorrectionRequest.title: CorrectionRequest

DataClass.description:
Who may see the text. The LLM gateway refuses to send anything but `synthetic`
to an endpoint that is not on the allowlist for its class.
DataClass.title: DataClass

edit.description: null when the rule builder, not a person, made the change

path.description: relative to the project, as a rule-set Citation.file names it, e.g. 'tender/09 Schedules.pdf' or 'bids/Tenderer_A/offer.pdf'
path.title: Path

page.description: Page in the bid where found
page.title: Page

Edit.description: Who changed something, when and why. Required on every human change.
Edit.title: Edit

detail.description: the message again, for the Streamlit UI until S5
detail.title: Detail

EssentialRequirement.description: One Stage II essential requirement (non-compliance disqualifies the offer).

source_file.description: Tender file (### FILE header) stating it
source_file.title: Source File

EssentialRequirement.title: EssentialRequirement

version.description: a confirmed rule-set version; default: the latest confirmed
version.title: Version

confidence.description: per field after V4: 1 for a value found on the text layer, the fraction of its words found otherwise; on a scan the mean of the two reads when they agree, half the lower when they differ
confidence.title: Confidence

FollowUp.description:
What a dormant outcome leads to: what triggers the request, by when the tenderer
must answer (prose, always present) and what a missed deadline means.
FollowUp.title: FollowUp

Gap.description:
A clause the schedule points to, or a 'shall/must' sentence, that no rule covers.
A gap blocks confirmation until a person gives a reason.

edit.description: who gave the reason, when and why

Gap.title: Gap

ItemNote.description:
Prose attached to an item that is not a check: a definition, what triggers a
requirement, a consequence stated in the clause, or a cross-reference.
ItemNote.title: ItemNote

ItemPatch.description:
`PATCH /ruleset/items/{letter}` (S3): one of slot, rule, template or note, with a reason.
A corrected slot keeps the model's value in `model_value`; the item becomes `edited`.
ItemPatch.title: ItemPatch

NewItem.description:
`POST /ruleset/items` (S3): an item a person adds from a clause; lettered x1, x2, ...
and `edited` with the person's edit record.
NewItem.title: NewItem

Node.description: One node of the clause tree L0 parsed from a document (`GET /documents/{doc_id}/nodes`).

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the marker, PDF points
box.title: Box

number.description: the marker as printed: a clause number or a label like (a)
number.title: Number

Node.title: Node

Normalise.description: A step applied to the field's value before the check, by the engine's own name.
Normalise.title: Normalise

NotePatch.description: `PATCH /ruleset/items/{letter}/notes/{i}`: the note as it should read, and why.
NotePatch.title: NotePatch

Outcome.description: The verdict for one outcome key. `note` may use {field} for the field's label.
Outcome.title: Outcome

PageCitation.description:
Where a value was read: the page, and a signed URL to its image. When the value is
found on the page's text layer, `quote` is that text as the page has it, `box` its
place and `image_url` renders it highlighted; on a scanned page all three stay plain
(quote and box null). Verified quotes on scanned pages arrive with V4 (S4).

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] around `quote`, PDF points, origin top-left, y down
box.title: Box

image_url.description: signed, short-lived; carries a signed `highlight` when `quote` is set. Use it as given: do not add or change query parameters
image_url.title: Image Url

page_size.description: [width, height] of the page in PDF points, set with `box`
page_size.title: Page Size

quote.description: the text the value was read from, as on the page's text layer
quote.title: Quote

PageCitation.title: PageCitation

Part.description: The Completeness Check Schedule's Parts: what a missing item means for the tender.
Part.title: Part

PartSpec.description:
A Part's intro in the Completeness Check Schedule: the paragraph that says what
happens when an item of that Part is missing or asked for, and the clauses it cites.
Located by L0; the engine reads the consequence from the Part.

citation.description: the Part's heading and intro paragraph

clauses.description: the clauses the intro points to
clauses.title: Clauses

PartSpec.title: PartSpec

PriceScheme.description: How the tender says price must be assessed. Drives which Price Summary format is used.

quantity.description: Estimated quantity from the Price Schedule
quantity.title: Quantity

source_file.description: Tender file (### FILE header) defining the scheme
source_file.title: Source File

Progress.description: How far a job's current step has got: `done` of `total` `unit`s (pages, calls, ...).
Progress.title: Progress

Project.description:
A project as `GET /projects` lists it and `GET /projects/{pid}` describes it (the
detail fields are null in the list).

status.description: an object, not a string: read status.state

Project.title: Project

ProjectStatus.title: ProjectStatus

ReasonBody.description: The body of a DELETE or a gap PATCH: why.
ReasonBody.title: ReasonBody

The evaluation rubric derived from one tender's documents. Saved as rubric.json

RuleSet.description:
A versioned rule set for one project. Draft until a person confirms it; editing a
confirmed set opens a new draft whose `parent_version` is the confirmed one.

parts.description: the Part intros the items sit under
parts.title: Parts

updated_by.description: who last saved this draft; server-owned, read-only
updated_by.title: Updated By

RuleSet.title: RuleSet

RuleSetItem.description:
One Completeness Check Schedule item, (a) to (o), with its rules. An item a person
adds has no schedule letter and is numbered x1, x2, ...

clauses.description: the clauses the row points to
clauses.title: Clauses

condition.description: the item applies only when this holds
condition.title: Condition

template.description: template id; None for a novel item
template.title: Template

RuleSetItem.title: RuleSetItem

updated_by.description: who last saved the draft; confirm refuses that person
updated_by.title: Updated By

SlotValue.description:
A filled slot. An extracted value must cite its source; `verified` is set only by
code. When a person corrects it, `origin` becomes manual, `model_value` keeps what the
model said, and `edit` records the change.
SlotValue.title: SlotValue

TemplateRule.description:
One check the engine runs on one vendor field. `params` hold literals or reference
slots as "{slot_name}"; the engine renders them per tender. A rule is a gate: it names
the consequence tier whose template defaults apply, or carries its own `outcomes`,
which replace the tier's defaults whole.

condition.description: applies only when this holds, e.g. 'not manufacturer'
condition.title: Condition

depends_on.description: rule ids that must pass first; the engine also accepts one id
depends_on.title: Depends On

TemplateRule.title: TemplateRule

Verification.description:
V4's check of a value (S4). On a page with a text layer the value was looked for
verbatim: found, `verified` with the quote on the citation and confidence 1. On a scanned
page a second, independent read was compared with the first: agreement verifies,
disagreement leaves the value unverified with `second_value` kept for the reviewer.
`verified` is null when nothing could be checked (redacted, blank on a text page, a
signature on a text layer, no page). An unverified value is `needs_review`.
Verification.title: Verification

post.description:
L0 to L4 on the tender's documents, as a job on the worker. The result is the draft
(a new one, or the open one replaced), never overwriting a person's edits: an edited
item keeps its version and a corrected slot gets the new suggestion as `model_value`.
409 while a build is running or when the project has no tender documents.

403 self_approval if the approver last edited the draft; 409 conflict with
`details.blockers` while an item needs input, a required slot of its template is
empty whatever the item's status (I1.15), or a gap has no reason. Confirms the draft
as version N.

get.description:
Items added, removed and changed between two versions; a change a person made
carries their edit record, one the rule builder made carries none.

put.description:
The whole draft as JSON, validated against app/rulesets/schema.py. The server owns
version, status and the audit fields.
